payload.summary: Developer hub pages repeat a labelled-section block 17 times; extract a PanelSection component
payload.detail: The five developer-hub pages (routes, documentation, test-health, review-state, ledger) each hand-maintain the pairing between a <section aria-labelledby={id}> and its <h2 id={id}>, 17 occurrences in total. A PanelSection({ id, title, count, children }) makes the labelled-region contract structural instead of remembered, and folds in the one inline <h3> class in documentation/page.tsx that escaped the shared primitives module. Raised by the Phase 2 whole-branch review and deliberately deferred: a five-file refactor of freshly reviewed pages inside a final fix wave is the change most likely to introduce the regression the wave exists to prevent. Safe to do on its own now that Phase 2 has landed.
